estimator.psd_definition: One-sided propagated single-record Hann density: PSD = 2|c|²/ENBW = bin_rms²/ENBW, Pa²/Hz; ENBW = fs sum(w²)/sum(w)². No second window, Welch averaging, stationarity or broadband/physical validation is implied. Selected-band sum(PSD * df) = coherent band RMS² * df/ENBW (2/3 for periodic Hann); this integral is not coherent synthesis mean square.
estimator.bin_rms_definition: bin_rms = sqrt(2)|c|, Pa; c has coherent Hann gain removed.
estimator.band_level_definition: 20 log10(original band_rms_pa / 1e-6), dB re 1 µPa; zero is null. Original coherent selected-band RMS is preserved, not replaced by PSD-integral RMS.

provenance.case_description: Single-phase strict-2D WALE; stationary permeable contour.
provenance.operation: Offline algebraic spectral extension only; no CFD or source reduction.
